evidence: generated-nightly-command.log records the substituted launchctl; actual job loading was not attempted.
reason: The workspace boundary forbids changing host launchd state. A deployment-capable run authorized for an isolated LaunchAgent must bootstrap, trigger, observe, and bootout the real job.

name: Cut over the main home on the PM’s word and remeasure it the following day
evidence: drift-proof.txt names the cutover and 2026-10-15 check-back; this run only used disposable repositories.
reason: This test phase has no authority to merge or change the external main-home checkout/config, and the next-day check is future work. The outer delivery owner needs the PM’s cutover authorization, then must deploy and remeasure on 2026-10-15.
